trial_court: Family Court, Kabirdham in Miscellaneous Criminal Case No. 337/2014
case_name: Ku. Tamanna vs Krishna on 28 March, 2024

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ku. Tamanna D/o Krishna Gond (Minor) and Dineshwari W/o Krishan Gond (Natural Guardian Mother)

facts_of_case: The applicants filed an application under Section 125 of CrPC for maintenance. The trial court allowed the application with respect to applicant No. 1 (child) and awarded ₹1500/- per month as maintenance, while rejecting the claim of applicant No. 2 observing that she is not a legally wedded wife of respondent.

legal_principles.principle: A claim for maintenance under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is not sustainable if there is no evidence that the applicant and respondent lived together as husband and wife.
legal_principles.held: Learned Family Court taking note of the decision in the cases of Smt. Yamunabai Anantrao Adhav vs. Anatraon Shivaram Adhav [AIR 1988 SC 644], Savitaben Somabhat Bhatiya vs. State of Gujarat [AIR 2005 SC 1809] and Hemlata Karayat vs. Vijay Kumar Karayat Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:11238 [II (2015) DMC (Chha.)] has rejected the claim sofar as relates to claim of maintenance of applicant No. 2.
cited_cases: Smt. Yamunabai Anantrao Adhav vs. Anatraon Shivaram Adhav [AIR 1988 SC 644]
Savitaben Somabhat Bhatiya vs. State of Gujarat [AIR 2005 SC 1809]
Hemlata Karayat vs. Vijay Kumar Karayat Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:11238 [II (2015) DMC (Chha.)]

legal_principles.principle: A claim for maintenance under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is not sustainable if there is a contradiction in the pleadings and evidence.
legal_principles.held: From the aforementioned statement of applicant no. 2 in her cross- examination, it appears that there is contradiction in the pleadings, facts pleaded as also her evidence before the Court.

outcome.final_order: The amount of maintenance awarded in favour of applicant no. 1 be enhanced and amount of maintenance to applicant no. 2 be also awarded.
